title: Q2 All-Hands (AI summary)
body:
Meeting summary (auto-generated)

Laura opened the all-hands by thanking everyone for a strong quarter. Revenue grew compared to the previous quarter, and customer satisfaction scores remained high. The leadership team highlighted the company values and the importance of collaboration across teams.

Engineering shared progress on the platform migration, which is expected to finish in Q3. Sales announced two new enterprise customers. The team plans to hire three more engineers in the second half of the year, possibly including candidates from outside the EU.

Operations mentioned that the office will get new meeting room screens. Several employees asked questions about the summer schedule, and Laura confirmed the office stays open during July and August with reduced catering.

The meeting closed with a quiz, which was won by the design team.
